run_image_generation_optimization: run the main entry point to optimize image generation using FLUX or Stable Diffusion 3 with LLM prompts
optimize_for_annotations_clip_scorer: optimize image prompts for annotations using a CLIP-based scorer to maximize image-text alignment scores
run_post_text_function: run the post text function to generate images from text descriptions using Stable Diffusion 3 or FLUX pipelines
build_args_parser: build an argument parser with configurable parameters for image model, text model, batch size, and optimization iterations
run_main_pipeline: run the main pipeline that loads annotations from CSV and iteratively optimizes image generation prompts using an LLM
